_comment: Judge config for the Streamly sandbox acceptance gate (scripts/sandbox_acceptance.py).
The judge is ALLOWED to know the sandbox: every selector, copy string, and route
below is grounded in streamly-sandbox source and real walk output. The walker
engine (sidira_crawler/) must never contain any of this.
Matchers are deterministic predicates over raw walk output — no fuzzy scoring.
Every manifest screen id needs an entry in screen_matchers; every mustDiscover
transition id needs an entry in transition_matchers. The harness hard-errors on gaps.

_evidence_notes.landing: hero h1 in src/pages/Landing.jsx; seen in smoke walks.
_evidence_notes.login: walker 'login' flag = visible password input; /login is the only password form at its own route.
_evidence_notes.login-wall: RequireAuth (src/auth.jsx) redirects guests to /login?next=<path>. No guest-visible link targets an authed route, so a link-following walker can only reach this via direct guarded-URL navigation.
_evidence_notes.signup-step-1: step-1 h1 in src/pages/Signup.jsx; seen in smoke walks.
_evidence_notes.signup-step-2: step-2 h1 'Choose a password' (client-side state, same URL).
_evidence_notes.consent-banner: banner copy in src/components/ConsentBanner.jsx; rides any route, so no route predicate.
_evidence_notes.profiles: chooser flag = walker's interstitial heuristic; h1 in src/pages/Profiles.jsx.
_evidence_notes.browse-eager: pre-scroll /browse: no end-of-catalog testid, no exhausted flag, no dialog. Absence-based by design — the eager state may be captured during its skeleton render phase, which the manifest counts as the same screen.
_evidence_notes.browse-lazy-rows: 'Trending Now' is a page-2 themed collection row (server/catalog.js) — present only after lazy rows + infinite scroll pages render.
_evidence_notes.browse-4k-row: row name '4K Ultra HD' (server/catalog.js fourKRow) leads page 1 for premium only; on /browse members only ever see plain '4K' poster badges.
_evidence_notes.title-modal: role=dialog aria-modal in src/components/TitleModal.jsx at deep-linkable /title/:id.
_evidence_notes.watch: 'Now playing ·' quality line in src/pages/Watch.jsx; seen in smoke walks.
_evidence_notes.plan-upgrade-confirm: 'Confirm upgrade' button only in the confirm stage of src/pages/Plan.jsx.
_evidence_notes.plan-upgrade-done: 'Order confirmed!' only in the done stage.
_evidence_notes.plan-downloads: 'Available offline on this device.' only in the premium Downloads section.
